editorial.blurb: Blue Frog Thai delivers bold, flavorful noodle dishes and standout appetizers at wallet-friendly prices, though consistency can be hit-or-miss.
editorial.insiderTip: Order the Pad Thai or chicken satay curry skewers and Thai iced coffee—ask the friendly staff for recommendations, and note they'll proactively ask about allergies. Skip lunch special hopes; they're no longer offered.
